description: This file defines an interface `ThingCommandAdapterProvider` that extends multiple generic provider interfaces related to command and event handling for 'things' in an Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter context. It aggregates various adapter provider interfaces for query, modify, message, error response, event, subscription event, and search command handling, parameterized with specific types relevant to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingCommandAdapterProvider
classes.description: An interface extending multiple provider interfaces to offer a unified set of adapters for handling commands, queries, modifications, events, subscriptions, searches, and errors related to 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter.
